unified_login_success_standard.rule: login success = auth_complete true and session_token present
unified_login_success_standard.user_identity_role: supplemental metadata only; not the login gate

frontend_state_machine_changes.summary: Stored auth sessions now require only authComplete=true and sessionToken. user is optional and may be null without invalidating auth state.
refresh() now treats any existing sessionToken as supplementalOnly, so /auth/me failure cannot clear a token-backed authenticated state.
login() writes the token snapshot and sets authenticated immediately after login response validation.
loginRequest disables retry and rejects only when auth_complete is not true or session_token is missing.
API requests attach X-Session-Token from the token snapshot and do not dispatch global unauthorized for /auth/login or /auth/me.
Login form distinguishes 401 invalid credentials from timeout/backend failures and blocks overlapping submits.

backend_session_changes.summary: Login response includes user, session_token, and auth_complete=true.
Unified session resolver accepts X-Session-Token first, Bearer second, cookie fallback last.
Authenticated dependencies use the unified session resolver.
The /auth/me short-circuit and control-plane isolation use the unified session resolver.
Org context middleware uses the unified resolver without changing org/RBAC rules.
Permission isolation receives the same resolved session id without RBAC engine changes.
Data isolation uses the same resolved session id.

race_condition_fixes.overlapping_login_requests: blocked by LoginForm isSubmittingRef and AuthProvider loginInFlightRef
race_condition_fixes.login_vs_auth_me: login increments session check generation and aborts pending session checks
race_condition_fixes.auth_me_late_failure: cannot clear auth when sessionToken exists
race_condition_fixes.route_change_abort: transient checks are aborted on route change without clearing token-backed auth
